title: Senior Manager
description:
**Title: Subject Matter Expert** 




**Location \- Noida** 




  





**About Paytm Group:** 
 Paytm is India’s leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid \- Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks’ financial instruments. To further enhance merchants’ business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.
 



**About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):** 
 PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm’s B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytm’s PA PG business in the Indian merchants.
 



  





**About the role:** 
 We are looking for highly driven and customer\-focused professionals to join our Enterprise Payments team as a Subject Matter Expert (SME). The role requires working closely with Sales, Product, and Business teams to drive merchant acquisition, solution consulting, and adoption of Paytm’s payment products. The SME will play a critical role in enabling enterprise sales by providing deep domain expertise in card payments, payment workflows, and digital payment solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the payments ecosystem, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate complex payment solutions into business value for enterprise merchants.
 



  





**Expectations / Requirements :** 




 ● Partner closely with enterprise sales teams to drive merchant acquisition and revenue growth by acting as a payments domain expert during client discussions and solution presentations.
 



 ● Engage with CXOs, payment heads, product teams, and business stakeholders to understand merchant requirements and recommend suitable payment solutions.
 



 ● Support sales teams in pitching Paytm’s payment suite including Card Payments, Tokenisation, International Card Payments, Pre\-auth \& Capture, Payment Gateway solutions, UPI, and value\-added payment products.
 



 ● Act as a trusted advisor for merchants by providing consultative solutioning aligned with their business models, payment flows, and customer experience goals.
 



 ● Work with Product and Technology teams to identify market requirements, product gaps, and opportunities for enhancing payment offerings.
 



 ● Contribute towards product ideation, competitive benchmarking, and feedback\-driven improvements to strengthen Paytm’s market positioning.
 



 ● Drive product adoption and merchant penetration by enabling successful onboarding, training, and solution implementation.
 



 ● Lead merchant\-facing discussions for new product launches, feature enhancements, and payment optimization initiatives.
 



 ● Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), use cases, and workflow recommendations to support product enhancements and digital\-first customer journeys.
 



 ● Coordinate with cross\-functional teams including Product, Compliance, Finance, Operations, Legal, and Technology to ensure seamless execution and faster resolution of merchant requirements.
 



 ● Track industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies within the payments and fintech ecosystem to strengthen sales strategy and customer engagement.
 



  





**Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed in this role :** 




 ● Minimum 5 years of experience in Payments, Fintech, Product Consulting, Solution Engineering, or Business Product Management with strong exposure to enterprise sales.
 



 ● Strong understanding of the card payments ecosystem including Card Processing, Tokenisation, Pre\-auth \& Capture, Payment Gateway flows, International Card Payments, and online/offline payment solutions.
 



 ● Ability to drive consultative and solution\-led sales conversations with enterprise merchants and senior stakeholders.
 



 ● Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to simplify complex payment concepts for business audiences.
 



 ● Experience working closely with cross\-functional teams and driving alignment between Sales, Product, and Technology teams.
 



 ● Proven ability to support GTM initiatives, product adoption strategies, and customer success programs.
 



 ● Strong analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data, customer insights, and market intelligence to influence business decisions.
 



 ● A self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, and dynamic fintech environment.
 



 ● Prior experience in fintech, payment gateways, banking, consulting, or enterprise solutioning roles will be an added advantage.
 



  





**Why join us:** 
 We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and how it will always be.
 



**Compensation:** 
 If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn\+ registered users, 21 mn\+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers \& merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and process\-driven GeM \& Tender Executive to manage our organization's end\-to\-end presence and business on the Government e\-Marketplace (GeM) portal and other government tender platforms (CPPP, e\-Procurement portals, state portals, etc.). The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience across the complete GeM lifecycle — from vendor onboarding and assessment to bidding, reverse auction, forward auction, order fulfilment, and payment realization.
   




**Key Responsibilities** 

  





***GeM Portal Management***




 •     Manage day\-to\-day operations on the GeM portal including seller/vendor profile management, catalogue creation, and product/service listing.
 



 •     Ensure timely completion of vendor assessment processes, including document submission, compliance checks, and empanelment requirements.
 



 •     Monitor and maintain OEM/vendor authorization, brand approval, and product category approvals on GeM.
 



 •     Keep vendor assessment score, seller rating, and compliance metrics updated and healthy.
 



  





***Bidding \& Tendering***




 •     Search, shortlist, and evaluate relevant Bids/RFPs (Direct Purchase, L1 Bid, Custom Bid) and tenders on GeM and other e\-procurement platforms.
 



 •     Prepare and submit techno\-commercial bids, ensuring accuracy of pricing, technical specifications, and compliance with tender terms.
 



 •     Track bid submission deadlines, EMD (Earnest Money Deposit) payment, and document submission timelines.
 



 •     Coordinate with internal teams (finance, technical, logistics) for tender document preparation, pricing strategy, and eligibility criteria fulfilment.
 



  





***Reverse Auction (RA)***




 •     Participate actively in Reverse Auction (RA) events, monitoring live bidding and applying competitive pricing strategies within approved cost limits.
 



 •     Analyze competitor pricing patterns and market rates to strategize bid decrements.
 



 •     Ensure timely and accurate participation in RA to maximize win rate while maintaining profitability.
 



  





***Forward Auction***




 •     Manage and participate in Forward Auction processes on GeM, ensuring compliance with auction rules and timelines.
 



 •     Coordinate pricing approvals internally before auction participation.
 



 •     Track auction outcomes and maintain records for management review.
 



  





***Order \& Contract Management***




 •     Process Purchase Orders (PO)/Contracts received via GeM — verify terms, acknowledge orders, and coordinate execution timelines.
 



 •     Track order fulfilment status: dispatch, delivery, installation (if applicable), and consignee acceptance.
 



 •     Manage CRAC (Consignee Receipt\-cum\-Acceptance Certificate) generation and follow\-up.
 



 •     Handle order cancellations, replacements, and returns as per GeM guidelines.
 



  





***Payments \& Compliance***




 •     Track and follow up on payment realization through GeM's integrated payment system (PFMS/bill processing).
 



 •     Ensure GST invoicing, e\-way bills, and other statutory compliance for each transaction.
 



 •     Maintain documentation for performance bank guarantees (PBG), EMD refunds, and other financial instruments as required.
 



  





***Reporting \& Coordination***




 •     Maintain MIS/trackers for bids submitted, RA/FA participation, orders won, and payment status.
 



 •     Liaise with government buyers, procurement officers, and internal stakeholders to resolve queries or disputes.
 



 •     Stay updated on GeM policy changes, GFR (General Financial Rules), and CVC guidelines relevant to public procurement.
   




**Required Skills \& Competencies** 

 •     Strong working knowledge of the GeM portal — bidding, RA, FA, catalogue management, and vendor assessment modules.
 



 •     Familiarity with public procurement processes, GFR, and government tendering norms.
 



 •     Good understanding of pricing strategy and competitive bidding techniques.
 



 •     Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint for tracking and reporting.
 



 •     Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
 



 •     Good communication and coordination skills for liaising with government departments and internal teams.
 



 •     Basic understanding of GST, e\-invoicing, and financial documentation related to tenders.
   




**Qualifications** 

 •     Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Engineering, or related field (MBA preferred but not mandatory).
 



 •     2–5 years of relevant experience in GeM operations, government tendering, or public sector sales.
 



 •     Prior experience working with GeM Sahayak/Seller Panel is a strong plus.
